opportunities.name: Mist AP second hit
opportunities.objective: Test AP supporting mist access, W control and ability-marked follow-up attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: W has 1 AP magic damage, E's movement speed scales with AP and Q's marked second attack includes 0.15 AP physical damage plus a heal. Nashor and Dusk support direct attacks during mist, while AP also enters possession healing. The first possession replaces Viego's current items with the victim's items.
opportunities.requiredState: Ability mark present, mist contact and target attackable; test pre-possession first.
opportunities.failure: Low AD weakens normal Q/R threat and possession interrupts the planned item budget.
opportunities.test: Separate W, first attack, Q follow-up and healing with AP varied; repeat before and during a specified possession.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Viego's six owned items are not continuously retained during possession.

opportunities.name: Heartbreaker crit window
opportunities.objective: Test source-explicit crit-stat scaling on Q and R before cashing an ultimate attack volley.
opportunities.mechanic: Q and R expose distinct crit-stat multiplier expressions; R also adds missing-health physical damage. Fiendhunter grants enhanced basic attacks after ultimate use and E supplies attack speed. Infinity Edge/Collector emphasize the opening, with armor penetration supporting confirmed physical packets.
opportunities.requiredState: R ready, specified crit stats, target health recorded and no possession item replacement during baseline.
opportunities.failure: R targets a different lowest-percent-health champion or the burst fails to secure the next soul.
opportunities.test: Vary crit chance/damage independently and log Q/R packets plus three post-R basic attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A crit-stat multiplier does not prove Q/R randomly crit or duplicate every attack effect.

ruledOut.reason: Possession replaces the victim's ultimate with a free cast of Viego's own R.

unknowns: Q second-hit item inheritance, R attack delivery and crit-stat semantics require logs; possession tests must name the victim and item state.

builds.name: Mist AP second hit
builds.summary: Test AP supporting mist access, W control and ability-marked follow-up attacks.
builds.goal: Test AP supporting mist access, W control and ability-marked follow-up attacks.
builds.hypothesis: W has 1 AP magic damage, E's movement speed scales with AP and Q's marked second attack includes 0.15 AP physical damage plus a heal. Nashor and Dusk support direct attacks during mist, while AP also enters possession healing. The first possession replaces Viego's current items with the victim's items.
testPlan: Required state: Ability mark present, mist contact and target attackable; test pre-possession first.
Separate W, first attack, Q follow-up and healing with AP varied; repeat before and during a specified possession.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD weakens normal Q/R threat and possession interrupts the planned item budget.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Viego's six owned items are not continuously retained during possession.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

The souls of enemy champions that die within [3] seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to Possess them, restoring [2 + (0.025) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.02) × AP + (5) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2] + (0.004) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]]% of enemy's max Health and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for [10] seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains [10]% Move Speed towards enemy champions.

Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by [10]%.

Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals [80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 + (1) × AP] magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for [0.25] to [1.25] seconds based on charge time.

Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional [(2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6) × (0.01)] current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing [(0.2) × AD + (0.15) × AP] physical damage and restoring [150]% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession.

Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing [(25 / 40 / 55 / 70 / 85 + (0.7) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.6) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage.
